intent: Every monitor kuhy connects runs at its native resolution and highest refresh rate automatically, with DP-0 primary on the left, without running xrandr by hand.
scope: linux_configuration/tests/test_monitor_layout.py, test_monitor_autoconfig.py, conftest.py; meta/pyproject.toml pylint init-hook path
Non-goal: reverting deliberate mode changes (games, manual xrandr); only connect/disconnect triggers a re-layout
changes: monitor_layout.py: parses xrandr --query and plans one row: native size at max refresh, preferred primary leftmost, disconnected outputs holding a CRTC switched off; returns [] when already there

monitor_autoconfig.py: systemd user service; RandR version handshake, listens for RROutputChangeNotify, settles 1 s, retries while a connected monitor lists no modes, logs and survives a failed xrandr
setup_monitor_autoconfig.sh installs deps, the user unit (WantedBy graphical-session.target) and starts it

verification.evidence: 23 passed, 100% line+branch coverage on both modules
unit enabled and active; layout DP-0 3840x2160@144 + HDMI-0 2560x1440@143.98 left unchanged (dry-run plan empty)
no events before the handshake, CrtcChange/ScreenChange events after it

risks: Physical hotplug not exercised on the real machine (kuhy declined the replug check); relies on the NVIDIA driver emitting RROutputChangeNotify on connect
rollback: xrandr layout stays as last applied
